segments.text:
V. 37.
And taking with him Peter and the two ſons of Zebedee—To be Witneſſes of all; he began to be ſorrowful and in deep anguiſh—Probably from feeling the Arrows of the Almighty ſtick faſt in his Soul, while GOD laid on Him the Iniquities of us all. Who can tell what painful and dreadful Senſations were then impreſt on Him by the immediate Hand of GOD? The former Word in the Original properly ſignifies, to be penetrated with the moſt exquiſite Sorrow; the latter, to be quite depreſt, and almoſt overwhelmed with the Load.
